## Location

Provide the repository path, heading, lesson, code block, or link.

## Problem

Describe what is incorrect, outdated, broken, or ambiguous.

## Proposed Correction

Provide the corrected wording, syntax, command, link, or explanation when known.

## Validation

Explain how the correction was verified. Include the IBM i release, tool version, or primary source when the detail is release-sensitive.

## Safety Check

- [ ] This report contains no credentials, private hostnames, customer information, proprietary code, production data, or sensitive screenshots.
- [ ] The material is safe to discuss publicly.

Sensitive problems must follow `SECURITY.md` and must not be posted in this issue.
